lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And here is the catch: the Bajau, sea nomads of Southeast Asia, have already grown a *bigger* tank.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Their divers spend up to sixty percent of a working day diving for *fish*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Scientists scanned the spleens of the Bajau and of their farming neighbours, the *Saluan*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Bajau spleen was about fifty percent *bigger*, roughly the size of a tennis ball.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It was big even in Bajau who do not dive, so it is in their *genes*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Scientists think it took only around a thousand years at sea, a *blink* for evolution.
